1	================================================================
2	            FDAgent 使用指南
3	            全栈设备监控 + AI 智能问答系统
4	================================================================
5	
6	目录：
7	  1. 安装 Docker
8	  2. 编译项目
9	  3. 运行项目
10	  4. 模型说明
11	  5. 常见问题
12	
13	
14	================================================================
15	1. 安装 Docker
16	================================================================
17	
18	如果您的机器尚未安装 Docker，请按以下步骤操作：
19	
20	【Ubuntu / Debian】
21	  # 一键安装（官方脚本）
22	  curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
23	
24	  # 将当前用户加入 docker 组（免 sudo）
25	  sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
26	  # 重新登录终端生效
27	
28	【CentOS / RHEL】
29	  sudo yum install -y yum-utils
30	  sudo yum-config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo
31	  sudo yum install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-compose-plugin
32	  sudo systemctl start docker
33	  sudo systemctl enable docker
34	
35	【macOS】
36	  下载安装 Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
37	
38	【Windows】
39	  下载安装 Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
40	  需开启 WSL2 后端（推荐）。
41	
42	验证安装：
43	  docker --version
44	  docker compose version
45	
46	确保两个命令都有输出，且 docker compose 版本 >= 2.0。
47	
48	
49	================================================================
50	2. 编译项目
51	================================================================
52	
53	进入项目根目录：
54	  cd fdagent
55	
56	首次编译（构建所有镜像，约需 10-30 分钟，取决于网络速度）：
57	  docker compose build
58	
59	说明：
60	  - 后端镜像基于 Python 3.11，会自动安装 PyTorch (CUDA) 及所有依赖
61	  - 前端镜像基于 Node.js 20，会自动安装 pnpm 及前端依赖
62	  - 首次构建会下载基础镜像和安装依赖，请耐心等待
63	  - 如需加速，可配置国内 Docker 镜像源
64	
65	如需重新构建（清除缓存）：
66	  docker compose build --no-cache
67	
68	
69	================================================================
70	3. 运行项目
71	================================================================
72	
73	启动所有服务：
74	  docker compose up
75	
76	后台运行（推荐）：
77	  docker compose up -d
78	
79	首次启动后，需要执行数据库迁移：
80	  docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate
81	
82	创建管理员账号（首次使用时）：
83	  docker compose exec backend python manage.py createsuperuser
84	
85	服务列表及端口：
86	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
87	  | 服务           | 端口   | 说明                             |
88	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
89	  | 前端 (Vue)     | 9527   | 浏览器访问入口                   |
90	  | 后端 (Django)  | 8080   | REST API                        |
91	  | MySQL 数据库    | 3306   | 数据存储                        |
92	  | Ollama (LLM)   | 11434  | 大语言模型服务                   |
93	  | Redis          | 内部   | Celery 消息队列（不对外暴露）    |
94	  | Celery Worker  | 内部   | 异步任务处理                    |
95	  | Celery Beat    | 内部   | 定时任务调度                    |
96	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
97	
98	访问系统：
99	  前端界面：http://localhost:9527
100	  后端 API：http://localhost:8080
101	
102	停止服务：
103	  docker compose down
104	
105	停止并清除数据（包括数据库）：
106	  docker compose down -v
107	
108	
109	================================================================
110	4. 模型说明
111	================================================================
112	
113	FDAgent 使用以下 AI 模型，均支持自动下载/拉取，无需手动操作：
114	
115	【大语言模型（Ollama）】
116	  默认模型：qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q8_0
117	  - 后端容器启动时会自动检查 Ollama 中是否已有所需模型
118	  - 如果缺失，会自动通过 Ollama API 拉取（首次拉取约需 20-60 分钟）
119	  - 建议 GPU 显存 >= 40GB（如 A100/A800/4090 等）
120	  - 如需更换模型，修改 docker-compose.yml 中的 LLM_MODEL 环境变量
121	
122	【嵌入模型（HuggingFace）】
123	  1. bge-large-zh-v1.5（中文向量模型，约 1.3GB）
124	     用途：RAG 知识库的文本向量化
125	  2. distiluse-base-multilingual-cased-v2（多语言模型，约 500MB）
126	     用途：RAG 检索结果重排序
127	  - 后端启动时会自动检测 backend/models/ 目录
128	  - 如果模型缺失，会自动从 HuggingFace 下载（使用 hf-mirror.com 镜像加速）
129	  - 下载完成后会缓存在本地，后续启动不再重复下载
130	  - 如需手动下载，可将模型放置到 backend/models/ 对应目录
131	
132	【时序预测模型（Moirai）】
133	  moirai-1.1-R-small / moirai-1.1-R-base
134	  - 用于能源监测子系统的负荷预测
135	  - 已内置在 backend/app_energy/pretrain/model/ 目录中
136	
137	
138	================================================================
139	5. 常见问题
140	================================================================
141	
142	Q: docker compose build 很慢怎么办？
143	A: 可以配置 Docker 镜像加速器。编辑 /etc/docker/daemon.json：
144	   {
145	     "registry-mirrors": [
146	       "https://mirror.ccs.tencentyun.com",
147	       "https://hub-mirror.c.163.com"
148	     ]
149	   }
150	   然后重启 Docker: sudo systemctl restart docker
151	
152	Q: 后端启动报数据库连接错误？
153	A: MySQL 容器启动需要几秒钟初始化。docker-compose.yml 中后端已配置
154	   depends_on，但如果仍报错，可等待 10 秒后重启后端：
155	   docker compose restart backend
156	
157	Q: Ollama 容器启动失败，提示 GPU 不可用？
158	A: 建议 GPU 显存 >= 40GB（如 A100/A800/4090 等），否则大模型推理可能因显存不足而失败。
159	   需要安装 NVIDIA Container Toolkit：
160	   # Ubuntu
161	   sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
162	   sudo systemctl restart docker
163	   如果没有 GPU，可编辑 docker-compose.yml 移除 ollama 服务的
164	   deploy.resources.reservations 部分，改用 CPU 模式运行。
165	
166	Q: 嵌入模型下载失败怎么办？
167	A: 检查网络连接，确认能访问 hf-mirror.com。如果在内网环境，可以：
168	   1. 在有网络的机器上下载模型，拷贝到 backend/models/ 目录
169	   2. 或设置 HF_ENDPOINT 环境变量指向可用的 HuggingFace 镜像
170	
171	Q: 前端页面打不开？
172	A: 确认前端容器正在运行：docker compose ps
173	   查看日志：docker compose logs frontend
174	   前端开发服务器启动需要 1-2 分钟。
175	
176	Q: 如何查看服务日志？
177	A: 查看所有服务日志：docker compose logs -f
178	   查看特定服务：docker compose logs -f backend
179	   查看最近 100 行：docker compose logs --tail 100 backend
180	
181	Q: 如何更新项目代码？
182	A: git pull 拉取最新代码后：
183	   docker compose build          # 重新构建（如有依赖变更）
184	   docker compose up -d          # 重启服务
185	   docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate  # 执行新迁移
186	
187	================================================================
188

8	  2. 编译项目
9	  3. 运行项目
10	  4. 模型说明
11	  5. 常见问题
12	
13	
14	================================================================
15	1. 安装 Docker
16	================================================================
17	
18	如果您的机器尚未安装 Docker，请按以下步骤操作：
19	
20	【Ubuntu / Debian】
21	  # 一键安装（官方脚本）
22	  curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
23	
24	  # 将当前用户加入 docker 组（免 sudo）
25	  sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
26	  # 重新登录终端生效
27	
28	【CentOS / RHEL】
29	  sudo yum install -y yum-utils
30	  sudo yum-config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo
31	  sudo yum install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-compose-plugin
32	  sudo systemctl start docker
33	  sudo systemctl enable docker
34	
35	【macOS】
36	  下载安装 Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
37	
38	【Windows】
39	  下载安装 Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/
40	  需开启 WSL2 后端（推荐）。
41	
42	验证安装：
43	  docker --version
44	  docker compose version
45	
46	确保两个命令都有输出，且 docker compose 版本 >= 2.0。
47	
48	
49	================================================================
50	2. 编译项目
51	================================================================
52	
53	进入项目根目录：
54	  cd fdagent
55	
56	首次编译（构建所有镜像，约需 10-30 分钟，取决于网络速度）：
57	  docker compose build
58	
59	说明：
60	  - 后端镜像基于 Python 3.11，会自动安装 PyTorch (CUDA) 及所有依赖
61	  - 前端镜像基于 Node.js 20，会自动安装 pnpm 及前端依赖
62	  - 首次构建会下载基础镜像和安装依赖，请耐心等待
63	  - 如需加速，可配置国内 Docker 镜像源
64	
65	如需重新构建（清除缓存）：
66	  docker compose build --no-cache
67	
68	
69	================================================================
70	3. 运行项目
71	================================================================
72	
73	启动所有服务：
74	  docker compose up
75	
76	后台运行（推荐）：
77	  docker compose up -d
78	
79	首次启动后，需要执行数据库迁移：
80	  docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate
81	
82	创建管理员账号（首次使用时）：
83	  docker compose exec backend python manage.py createsuperuser
84	
85	服务列表及端口：
86	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
87	  | 服务           | 端口   | 说明                             |
88	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
89	  | 前端 (Vue)     | 9527   | 浏览器访问入口                   |
90	  | 后端 (Django)  | 8080   | REST API                        |
91	  | MySQL 数据库    | 3306   | 数据存储                        |
92	  | Ollama (LLM)   | 11434  | 大语言模型服务                   |
93	  | Redis          | 内部   | Celery 消息队列（不对外暴露）    |
94	  | Celery Worker  | 内部   | 异步任务处理                    |
95	  | Celery Beat    | 内部   | 定时任务调度                    |
96	  +----------------+--------+----------------------------------+
97	
98	访问系统：
99	  前端界面：http://localhost:9527
100	  后端 API：http://localhost:8080
101	
102	停止服务：
103	  docker compose down
104	
105	停止并清除数据（包括数据库）：
106	  docker compose down -v
107	
108	
109	================================================================
110	4. 模型说明
111	================================================================
112	
113	FDAgent 使用以下 AI 模型，均支持自动下载/拉取，无需手动操作：
114	
115	【大语言模型（Ollama）】
116	  默认模型：qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q8_0
117	  - 后端容器启动时会自动检查 Ollama 中是否已有所需模型
118	  - 如果缺失，会自动通过 Ollama API 拉取（首次拉取约需 20-60 分钟）
119	  - 建议 GPU 显存 >= 40GB（如 A100/A800/4090 等）
120	  - 如需更换模型，修改 docker-compose.yml 中的 LLM_MODEL 环境变量
121	
122	【嵌入模型（HuggingFace）】
123	  1. bge-large-zh-v1.5（中文向量模型，约 1.3GB）
124	     用途：RAG 知识库的文本向量化
125	  2. distiluse-base-multilingual-cased-v2（多语言模型，约 500MB）
126	     用途：RAG 检索结果重排序
127	  - 后端启动时会自动检测 backend/models/ 目录
128	  - 如果模型缺失，会自动从 HuggingFace 下载（使用 hf-mirror.com 镜像加速）
129	  - 下载完成后会缓存在本地，后续启动不再重复下载
130	  - 如需手动下载，可将模型放置到 backend/models/ 对应目录
131	
132	【时序预测模型（Moirai）】
133	  moirai-1.1-R-small / moirai-1.1-R-base
134	  - 用于能源监测子系统的负荷预测
135	  - 已内置在 backend/app_energy/pretrain/model/ 目录中
136	
137	
138	================================================================
139	5. 常见问题
140	================================================================
141	
142	Q: docker compose build 很慢怎么办？
143	A: 可以配置 Docker 镜像加速器。编辑 /etc/docker/daemon.json：
144	   {
145	     "registry-mirrors": [
146	       "https://mirror.ccs.tencentyun.com",
147	       "https://hub-mirror.c.163.com"
148	     ]
149	   }
150	   然后重启 Docker: sudo systemctl restart docker
151	
152	Q: 后端启动报数据库连接错误？
153	A: MySQL 容器启动需要几秒钟初始化。docker-compose.yml 中后端已配置
154	   depends_on，但如果仍报错，可等待 10 秒后重启后端：
155	   docker compose restart backend
156	
157	Q: Ollama 容器启动失败，提示 GPU 不可用？
158	A: 建议 GPU 显存 >= 40GB（如 A100/A800/4090 等），否则大模型推理可能因显存不足而失败。
159	   需要安装 NVIDIA Container Toolkit：
160	   # Ubuntu
161	   sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
162	   sudo systemctl restart docker
163	   如果没有 GPU，可编辑 docker-compose.yml 移除 ollama 服务的
164	   deploy.resources.reservations 部分，改用 CPU 模式运行。
165	
166	Q: 嵌入模型下载失败怎么办？
167	A: 检查网络连接，确认能访问 hf-mirror.com。如果在内网环境，可以：
168	   1. 在有网络的机器上下载模型，拷贝到 backend/models/ 目录
169	   2. 或设置 HF_ENDPOINT 环境变量指向可用的 HuggingFace 镜像
170	
171	Q: 前端页面打不开？
172	A: 确认前端容器正在运行：docker compose ps
173	   查看日志：docker compose logs frontend
174	   前端开发服务器启动需要 1-2 分钟。
175	
176	Q: 如何查看服务日志？
177	A: 查看所有服务日志：docker compose logs -f
178	   查看特定服务：docker compose logs -f backend
179	   查看最近 100 行：docker compose logs --tail 100 backend
180	
181	Q: 如何更新项目代码？
182	A: git pull 拉取最新代码后：
183	   docker compose build          # 重新构建（如有依赖变更）
184	   docker compose up -d          # 重启服务
185	   docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate  # 执行新迁移
186	
187	================================================================
188

87 88
89 90 Abstract: Understanding camera dynamics is a fundamental pillar of video spatial intelligence. However, existing multimodal models predominantly treat this task as a black-box classification, often confusing physically distinct motions by relying on superficial visual patterns rather than geometric cues. We present **CamReasoner**, a framework that reformulates camera movement understanding as a structured inference process to bridge the gap between perception and cinematic logic. Our approach centers on the Observation-Thinking-Answer (O-T-A) paradigm, which compels the model to decode spatio-temporal cues such as trajectories and view frustums within an explicit reasoning block. To instill this capability, we construct a Large-scale Inference Trajectory Suite comprising 18k SFT reasoning chains and 38k RL feedback samples. Notably, we are the **first to employ RL for logical alignment in this domain**, ensuring motion inferences are grounded in physical geometry rather than contextual guesswork. By applying Reinforcement Learning to the Observation-Think-Answer (O-T-A) reasoning paradigm, CamReasoner effectively suppresses hallucinations and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks. 91 92 93 ## 🕹️ Usage 94 95 ### Supervised Fine-tuning 96 97 Supervised Fine-Tuning establishes a foundational reasoning baseline by injecting structured templates and domain-specific knowledge, enabling the model to follow instructions and generate coherent initial responses. 98 99 ```bash 100 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 101 cd CamReasoner 102 103 # build SFT environment 104 conda create -n sft python=3.11 105 conda activate sft 106 cd LLaMA-Factory 107 bash setup.sh 108 109 # download data 110 bash download.sh 111 112 # run sft (modify parameters according to your need) 113 bash local_scripts/run_sft.sh 114 ``` 115 116 Our proposed SFT dataset **CamReasoning-SFT-18k** is in [camerabench_sft.json](LLaMA-Factory/data/camerabench_sft.json). If you want to train models on your own curated data, you can convert their format as shown in our json file. 117 118 ### Reinforcement Learning 119 120 Reinforcement Learning drives the model to self-evolve through trial and error, refining the internal logic chain and optimizing decision-making performance beyond the limitations of static training data. 121 122 ```bash 123 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 124 cd CamReasoner 125 126 # build RL environment 127 conda create -n rl python=3.11 128 conda activate rl 129 cd EasyR1 130 bash setup.sh 131 132 # download data 133 bash download.sh 134 135 # run rl (modify parameters according to your need) 136 bash local_scripts/run_rl.sh 137 ``` 138 139 Our proposed RL dataset **CamReasoning-RL-38k** is in [camerabench_rl.json](EasyR1/camerabench_rl.json). If you want to train models on your own curated data, you can convert their format as shown in our json file. 140 141 142 For more details for the SFT and RL environment installation, please refer to [LLaMA-Factory](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory), [EasyR1](https://github.com/hiyouga/EasyR1) 143 144 ### Inference 145 146 You can use CamReasoner-7B to inference and see the reasoning process following this part. We provide the results in [CamReasoner_binary.json](Inference/results/CamReasoner_binary.json) and [CamReasoner_vqa.json](Inference/results/CamReasoner_vqa.json) to help visualizing the observe-think-answer reasoning paradigm. 147 148 ```bash 149 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 150 cd CamReasoner 151 152 # build inference environment 153 conda create -n infer python=3.11 154 conda activate infer 155 cd Inference 156 bash setup.sh 157 158 # download data 159 python data_download.py 160 161 # run inference (modify parameters according to your need) 162 bash infer/infer.sh 163 ``` 164 165 The evaluation data are from [CameraBench](https://github.com/sy77777en/CameraBench), including questions and videos. You can refer to [CameraBench](https://github.com/sy77777en/CameraBench) for more details. 166 167 You can also refer to [ShotBench](https://github.com/Vchitect/ShotBench) and [RefineShot](https://github.com/wuhang03/RefineShot) for out-of-domain camera movement understanding evaluation and reasoning reliability evaluation. These evaluation can be run simply modifying `MODEL_NAME` and `CATEGORY` in evaluate_qwen.sh in [RefineShot](https://github.com/wuhang03/RefineShot). 168 169 ## 📈 Training Curves 170 171

Here is a thorough report of the codebase at `/data/agent/choucisan`.

---

## 1. What the Project Is About

This is a **research workspace** -- not a single cohesive software project, but rather a collection of independent sub-projects, research experiments, algorithm implementations, and utility scripts. The primary research focus is on **UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) video understanding** using multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Key themes:

- **MotionGuide**: A motion-aware multimodal LLM for UAV video reasoning, built on top of Qwen2.5-VL. The work involves LoRA adapter training, task-vector fusion (inspired by FRANK), and training-free inference strategies.
- **CamReasoner**: A separate but related project for camera movement understanding via structured spatial reasoning (Observation-Thinking-Answer paradigm), using SFT + reinforcement learning.
- **FDAgent**: A full-stack device monitoring + AI Q&A system (Django backend, Vue3 frontend, Ollama LLM, Redis/Celery, MySQL).
- Various standalone algorithm/data-structure implementations and ETL pipeline utilities.

The main planning document is `/data/agent/choucisan/plan.md`, which describes a training-free task-vector fusion experiment for injecting reasoning capabilities into a MotionGuide model.

---

## 2. Languages and Frameworks Used

The workspace is **polyglot**. Here is the breakdown:

**Python** (primary language for research):
- PyTorch, DeepSpeed (model training)
- SQLAlchemy, PyArrow/Parquet (ETL pipelines)
- httpx (HTTP client in API ETL)
- pandas, matplotlib (data processing and visualization)
- yaml (configuration)
- FastAPI + uvicorn (analytics-api, though the app is scaffold-only)

**TypeScript/JavaScript** (frontend):
- Vue 3 + Vite 7 + TypeScript + NaiveUI + UnoCSS (fdagent frontend, based on Soybean Admin template)
- OpenAI SDK (`openai` npm package)
- pnpm package manager

**Go**:
- Standard library SMTP email sender (`/data/agent/choucisan/email/`)
- A full Go source tree at `/data/agent/choucisan/go/` (this is the Go programming language source code itself, not application code)

**Rust**:
- Debounce thread pool (`/data/agent/choucisan/debounce_pool/`) -- a thread pool with debounced task submission

**Ruby**:
- Redis-based distributed lock manager (`/data/agent/choucisan/ruby-distributed-lock/`)

**C++**:
- A Makefile template at `/data/agent/choucisan/Makefile` for a C++17 project (with clang-tidy linting). No actual `.cpp` source files exist yet under `src/` or `include/`.

**Shell/Bash**:
- Experiment runner scripts (`run_all.sh`, various `run_eval.sh`, `run_train.sh`)

**LaTeX**:
- Academic paper (`/data/agent/choucisan/paper.tex`) and weekly report

---

## 3. Proxy Servers, HTTP Servers, and Google Sheets API Integrations

**HTTP Servers:**
- `/data/agent/choucisan/analytics-api/` -- A **FastAPI** application skeleton. The `requirements.txt` includes `fastapi==0.115.6` and `uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0`. However, the `app/__init__.py` and all sub-module `__init__.py` files are **empty** -- this is scaffold only, with no actual routes or logic implemented yet.
- `/data/agent/choucisan/fdagent/` -- The FDAgent backend is a **Django** application (has `manage.py`, `requirements.txt`), served behind Docker Compose on port 8080. The frontend is a Vue3 app served on port 9527.
- `/data/agent/choucisan/etl_pipeline.py` line 100 -- uses `eval()` inside a `compute_field` transform, which is a potential security concern but not an HTTP server.

**HTTP Clients (not servers):**
- `/data/agent/choucisan/api_etl_pipeline.py` -- Uses `httpx` to fetch data from JSON APIs with pagination, retries, and rate limiting. This is an HTTP **client** for ETL, not a server.

**Proxy Servers:**
- No dedicated proxy server implementations were found. The word "proxy" appears in the codebase only in the context of DeepSpeed's `proxy` settings in checkpoint conversion scripts and `proxy-from-env` npm dependency in the frontend.

**Google Sheets API:**
- No Google Sheets integration exists in the project's own code. The only reference is a plugin configuration file at `/data/agent/choucisan/.my-codex/.tmp/plugins/plugins/google-drive/skills/google-sheets/agents/openai.yaml`, which appears to be part of a Codex plugin system, not project code.

---

## 4. Compression Libraries and Patterns

**Direct compression library usage in project code is minimal:**
- `/data/agent/choucisan/log_etl_pipeline.py` -- Uses **PyArrow** (`pyarrow.parquet`) for writing Parquet files, which uses Snappy compression by default. This is the only compression-adjacent pattern in the project's own code.
- The fdagent frontend has references to `compress` in its build toolchain (Vite/Sass), but these are build-time CSS/JS minification, not data compression.

**In vendored/third-party code:**
- DeepSpeed checkpoint scripts (`zero_to_fp32.py`) reference zstd compression for model weights.
- The `flash-attention-2.7.4` directory contains CUDA kernels with various compression-related code.
- The `fdagent/backend/app_energy/pretrain/` directory has many config files named `compressor_*.yaml` related to time-series forecasting model compression, but these are part of the Moirai forecasting framework, not general-purpose compression.

**No usage of:** gzip, zlib, brotli, lz4, or zstd in the project's own Python/JS/Go/Rust/Ruby source files.

---

## 5. Overall Directory Structure

|
|-- plan.md                          # Research plan: training-free task-vector fusion
|-- run_all.sh                       # Main experiment runner (MotionGuide LoRA fusion)

|   |-- fibonacci.py                 # Fibonacci sequence
|   |-- test_aho_corasick.py         # Tests for Aho-Corasick
|   |-- rate_limiter.py              # Connection pool with health checks (Python)

|   |-- message_queue.py             # Priority queue with delayed scheduling

# Google Sheets API Compression Proxy

## Context

Build a standalone proxy server that sits between clients and the Google Sheets API (sheets.googleapis.com), transparently adding gzip/deflate compression to responses and decompressing request bodies. This reduces bandwidth for large spreadsheet reads/writes — a common need when working with big sheets.

## Approach

**Python + FastAPI + httpx** — fits the existing workspace (the `analytics-api/` scaffold already has FastAPI and httpx in requirements).

## Files to Create

### `sheets_proxy/` (new directory)

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `server.py` | FastAPI app — main entry point |
| `forwarder.py` | Proxy logic: forward requests to Sheets API with compression |
| `auth.py` | Google Sheets auth (service account + OAuth2 passthrough) |
| `compression.py` | Middleware for request decompression and response compression |
| `config.py` | Settings via env vars |
| `requirements.txt` | Dependencies |
| `README.md` | Usage instructions |
| `tests/test_proxy.py` | Tests with mocked Sheets API |

## Implementation Details

### 1. `server.py` — FastAPI App
- Catch-all route: `@app.api_route("/sheets/{path:path}", methods=["GET","POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE"])`
- Mount compression middleware
- Health check endpoint at `/health`
- CORS support

### 2. `compression.py` — Middleware
- **Response**: Accept-Encoding negotiation (gzip, deflate). Compress JSON responses > 1KB. Set `Content-Encoding` header.
- **Request**: Detect `Content-Encoding: gzip/deflate` on incoming requests, decompress before forwarding.
- Use Python stdlib `gzip` and `zlib` modules.

### 3. `forwarder.py` — Request Forwarder
- Build target URL: `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/{path}`
- Forward headers (strip hop-by-hop headers)
- Stream large responses
- Pass through query parameters unchanged
- Handle Sheets API error responses

### 4. `auth.py` — Authentication
- **Service account**: Load JSON key file via `google-auth` library, inject Bearer token.
- **Passthrough**: If `Authorization` header is present in the incoming request, forward it as-is.
- Auto-detect mode based on presence of `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE` env var.

### 5. `config.py` — Configuration
- `PROXY_PORT` (default 8100)
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE` (path to key JSON)
- `SHEETS_API_BASE` (default `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4`)
- `MIN_COMPRESS_SIZE` (default 1024 bytes)
- `LOG_LEVEL`

### 6. `requirements.txt`
```
fastapi>=0.115.0
uvicorn[standard]>=0.34.0
httpx>=0.27.0
google-auth>=2.0.0
```

### 7. `tests/test_proxy.py`
- Test compression middleware (gzip round-trip)
- Test auth injection (service account and passthrough)
- Test full proxy flow with mocked Sheets API (using httpx mock or pytest-httpx)
- Test large response streaming

## Verification

1. `cd sheets_proxy && pip install -r requirements.txt`
2. `python -m pytest tests/ -v`
3. Manual test: `curl -H "Accept-Encoding: gzip" http://localhost:8100/sheets/spreadsheets/SPREADSHEET_ID/values/Sheet1 --compressed`
